claims.text: AI dictation types voice into any app, fully on device, Mac only

quote.text: AI dictation that types your voice into any app, fully on device (Mac only)

claims.text: Codes must be redeemed within 60 days of purchase

quote.text: You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase

claims.text: Transcription and AI cleanup run on Mac and work with Wi-Fi turned off

quote.text: Yes. Transcription and AI cleanup both run on your Mac, so Rhino works with Wi-Fi turned off.

claims.text: Requires macOS 14 or later, app is signed and notarized by Apple

quote.text: macOS 14 or later on any Mac. The app is signed and notarized by Apple.

claims.text: No audio or text leaves the machine, history saved locally and deletable

quote.text: No audio or text ever leaves your machine. History is saved locally and you can delete it at any time.

claims.text: Works in any app that accepts typed text including Slack, Gmail, Notion, Xcode

quote.text: Any app that accepts typed text, including Slack, Gmail, Notion, Xcode, and the terminal.

claims.text: No login, no account, and no telemetry

quote.text: No. There is no login, no account, and no telemetry.

claims.text: First version shipped August 11, 2026 with updates most weeks

quote.text: The first version shipped on August 11, 2026, and updates land most weeks. The public changelog lists every change.

claims.text: Personal dictionary fixes wrong words for names and jargon

quote.text: Add it to the personal dictionary and Rhino will get it right from then on, which is how most people handle names and jargon.

claims.text: Every future update to Rhino is included at no extra cost

quote.text: Yes. Every future update to Rhino is included at no extra cost.

trials.claim: Every future update to Rhino is included at no extra cost
trials.claimQuote: Yes. Every future update to Rhino is included at no extra cost.

trials.claim: AI dictation types voice into any app, fully on device, Mac only
trials.claimQuote: AI dictation that types your voice into any app, fully on device (Mac only)
trials.reasoning: The vendor states words show up in any app and nothing goes to the cloud; the single focus-change report does not show an app where dictation cannot type when that app is in use.

exhibits.quote: when I finish my dictation nothing will populate because I clicked off the app I am talking to even though the bubble still shows it is recording me.
exhibits.argument: The quote shows dictation fails to insert text if focus changes, undermining the claim it types into any app.

exhibits.quote: Hold one key, say it, let go. Your words show up in any app: email, Slack, docs, ChatGPT.
exhibits.argument: Quote confirms voice types into any app as claimed.

exhibits.quote: Nothing goes to the cloud, so it works even with Wi-Fi off.
exhibits.argument: Quote confirms processing is fully on device with no cloud use.

trials.claim: Transcription and AI cleanup run on Mac and work with Wi-Fi turned off
trials.claimQuote: Yes. Transcription and AI cleanup both run on your Mac, so Rhino works with Wi-Fi turned off.
trials.reasoning: The vendor says nothing goes to the cloud and it works with Wi-Fi off, and a review confirms local LLM models are downloaded and used.

exhibits.quote: Nothing goes to the cloud, so it works even with Wi-Fi off.
exhibits.argument: Quote confirms the app works with Wi-Fi turned off.

exhibits.quote: The activation, the setup, the download of the various local LLM models, absolutely fantastic.
exhibits.argument: Quote confirms AI models run locally on the Mac.

themes.summary: Many buyers say dictation and transcription work fast, accurately, and reliably.

This is literally the best app I've tried.
The dictation is perfect, and i love it keeps record of all the dications.
It's quick, responsive, and quite elegant to use.
I really love this app and use it all the time.
For the most part this product works good and can't go wrong with the price.
Everything went smoothly and the first tests worked perfectly.
Rhino delivers better results than the service I was paying for.
More reliable than Wispr Flow, which often doesn’t paste even when there’s an active cursor in an app.
for dictation, I’ve found that Rhino Voice works much better for me.
it works great -- very fast and accurate!
So far, it is working - i just use in English, on my Mac, simple tasks.
